_description: Standardized exit codes and error categories across RemarkablePC engineering suites

descriptions.101: Invalid command-line arguments or parameters provided.
descriptions.102: Administrative elevation required to execute operation.
descriptions.103: Target storage drive or volume not found.
descriptions.104: Windows Imaging Format (.wim/.esd) file is corrupted or unreadable.
descriptions.105: Insufficient disk space on target volume.
descriptions.106: Drive is BitLocker locked or missing required recovery key.
descriptions.107: Source installation image or rescue ISO is missing.
descriptions.108: Operation explicitly cancelled or aborted by user.
descriptions.109: Network download failed or server unreachable.
descriptions.110: Failed to create or mount RAM scratchpad / temporary volume.
descriptions.111: DISM apply or restore operation failed.
descriptions.112: Hardware/kernel write-blocker engaged; write operation refused.
